text.p: The following is a direct contribution from commodity statistician F.O. Licht in Ratzeburg, Germany. Please address any queries to Helmut Ahlfeld on +00 49 4541 88920.

White sugar futures in London closed lower across the board. The nearby March/May spread was in the spotlight, opening above $6.00, but trading mostly between $4.50 and $5.00. March finished $3.10 lower at $304.90 per tonne, while May gave up $2.50 to close at $301.50 per tonne.

Raw sugar futures in New York closed mostly lower. However, spot March added 3 points to close at 10.66 cents/lb, while May ended 3 points lower at 10.65 cents/lb. The outer months lost between 4 and 5 points. Trade scale-up selling capped the March contract at 10.69 cents/lb, below resistance at 10.70 cents/lb.
